items.title: Flycast adds bounded NEON paths for ARM64 framebuffer work
items.summary: Flycast now uses ARM64 NEON for framebuffer conversion and VRAM writes, while retaining scalar fallbacks for unaligned or unsupported cases. A physical-VRAM bounds check keeps vector reads inside both 8 MB and 16 MB memory configurations.

items.title: Flycast rejects disc descriptors with unfinished quoted filenames
items.summary: A CUE or GDI FILE line ending before its closing quote could leave Flycast’s parser reading indefinitely. The reader now checks every character extraction and raises an invalid-descriptor error at end of file, preventing a malformed text file from hanging disc loading.

sources.title: Merged CUE and GDI parser changes

items.title: Flycast brings per-pixel sorting to OpenGL ES 3.1
items.summary: The libretro OpenGL ES path can now request the GLES 3.1 context and verify the image atomics, shader-storage blocks, counters, bindings, and buffer limits required by Flycast’s order-independent transparency renderer.

sources.title: gles: enable OIT with OpenGL ES 3.1

items.title: Flycast reads MIL-CD session gaps from CHD track metadata
items.summary: Dreamcast MIL-CD images can describe a second session with a lead-out, lead-in, and pregap that must be reflected in disc time. Flycast’s CHD reader now accounts for those gaps and interprets pregap metadata instead of assuming every track begins at its stored frame boundary.

sources.title: chd: MIL-CD support for images with pregaps

items.title: Flycast enables translucent depth masking for Monkey Ball’s minimap
items.summary: Flycast’s arcade-specific boot settings now apply translucent polygon depth masking to Monkey Ball Japan Version as well as Cosmic Smash in Japan. The title-specific override targets the minimap rendering path without changing the global graphics default for other games.

sources.title: Fix Monkey Ball minimap depth masking

items.title: mGBA’s ARM debugger now exposes processor mode and SPSR state
items.summary: The command-line debugger already printed packed ARM program-status bits, but users still had to decode the privileged mode and inspect banked state indirectly. mGBA now labels the PSR mode and includes the saved PSR register in its register listing.

sources.title: feat(debugger): show PSR mode field in register dump, show SPSR

items.title: mGBA rescales cached DMA offsets when GBA audio forces 32-bit FIFO transfers
items.summary: A FIFO DMA can be programmed at 16-bit width, then converted to 32-bit transfers by the GBA audio path. mGBA now rescales the cached source step to plus or minus four bytes, preserving direction and preventing doubled or misaligned sample reads.

sources.title: fix(gba/audio): rescale the FIFO DMA source offset to 32-bit width

items.title: mGBA initializes Lua register reads before returning 8-bit values
items.summary: The Game Boy scripting API returned an `int32_t`, but its register callback wrote only the low byte for 8-bit registers. Initializing the output to zero before the callback prevents leftover stack bytes from appearing as random high bits in Lua.

sources.title: fix(lua/gb): emu:readRegister() returns garbage in high bytes

items.title: mGBA installs custom save-state PNG handlers before reading image data
items.summary: PNG save states can carry mGBA’s `gbAs` and `gbAx` chunks before the image IDAT data. The loader now registers its custom-chunk handler before reading the PNG header, so libpng recognizes those chunks regardless of their position.

sources.title: PNG save states: Allow custom PNG chunks to appear before the IDAT chunk again

items.title: mGBA replaces its sinc audio interpolator with a windowed lookup kernel
items.summary: The old sinc path mishandled its removable singularity at zero and stored separate sinc and window tables. mGBA now builds a modified Lanczos-style, flat-top windowed-sinc lookup and sums a fixed 16-sample neighborhood, reducing table memory and interpolation work.

items.title: xemu ties the MCPX audio counter to processed samples
items.summary: The Xbox audio register NV_PAPU_XGSCNT was reporting elapsed virtual time as though it were a sample count. xemu now derives the value from its emulated frame divider and samples per frame, addressing voice desynchronization reported in Innocent Tears.

sources.title: apu: Return sample count for NV_PAPU_XGSCNT

items.title: xemu rounds NV2A alarm deadlines up to avoid timer loops
items.summary: Truncating fractional clock conversions could schedule an Xbox GPU alarm too early and repeatedly reschedule it at the same instant. xemu now rounds conversions and tick distances upward, handles alarm wrap explicitly, and avoids host timers when the guest interrupt is disabled.

sources.title: nv2a: Fix rounding issue in timer scheduling

items.title: xemu hardens NV2A surface handling for empty render regions
items.summary: An Xbox game can leave the emulated GPU with a surface whose clip region has zero width or height. xemu now skips transfers and CPU access tracking for those surfaces while giving host graphics APIs safe one-pixel placeholders.

items.title: xemu preserves sharp Xbox 2D surfaces when scaling in Vulkan
items.summary: When the CPU writes an Xbox surface in VRAM, xemu uploads it and may scale it for a higher internal resolution. The Vulkan path now uses nearest-neighbor blits for both upload upscaling and download downscaling, matching pixel replication instead of adding linear blur.

sources.title: nv2a/vk: Fix blurry 2D/UI rendering at internal resolutions > 1x

items.title: xemu adds a switchable JIT engine for the Xbox audio DSP
items.summary: A new DSP56300 backend gives xemu an alternative to interpreting every guest instruction. A shared state layer keeps the existing interpreter available and connects both engines to save-state handling.

sources.title: apu: Add new DSP56300 emulator with JIT execution engine

items.title: RPCS3 clears stale PPU delay when starting a thread
items.summary: A PPU scheduling adjustment resets the sleep delay after a wait and checks the current function before applying the thread-start heuristic.

sources.title: PPU: reset sleep delay after thread start

items.title: RPCS3 resets CellAudio tag state across port layouts
items.summary: A per-port front-channel flag now tracks when CellAudio tag handling must change between stereo and surround layouts, addressing a reported slow-audio case.

items.title: RPCS3 parallelizes Vulkan boot shader compilation
items.summary: RPCS3 can use host threads for the initial Vulkan pipe compiler, then resize the pool after shader cache loading to honor the configured runtime setting.

sources.title: Vulkan: compile boot shaders in parallel

items.title: RPCS3 scopes a Vulkan query workaround to Mesa Turnip
items.summary: A GPU hang report led RPCS3 to enable strict query scopes for Turnip while leaving Qualcomm’s proprietary driver on its existing path.

sources.title: Vulkan: enable strict query scopes for Turnip

items.title: RPCS3 narrows the SPU putllc reservation lock
items.summary: A new fast path handles a 128-byte reservation line with a smaller locked region and a 16-byte atomic compare-and-swap when accurate reservations are disabled.

items.title: EmuCoreR builds a handheld home for SwanStation on Android
items.summary: A PlayStation 1 emulator and game library built around the SwanStation libretro core, combining hardware renderers, handheld-first controls, and integrated cheat, texture pack and RetroAchievements support.

sources.title: EmuCoreR Android application and JNI frontend repository

items.title: PPSSPP preserves filesystem order in older save states
items.summary: The loader accounts for known filesystem additions when restoring an older save state. A test-runner correction also ensures that requested loads actually execute.

sources.title: Fix savestate breakage related to file system mounts

items.title: PCSX2 corrects depth precision on Apple GPUs with Metal
items.summary: Different depth calculations can make surfaces disappear. A targeted change to the Metal renderer makes the relevant comparisons more consistent on Apple GPUs.

sources.title: GS:MTL: Add workaround for Apple GPU hardware bug

items.title: Azahar refreshes looping PCM audio when games rewrite the buffer
items.summary: The correction reads changed audio samples and tracks playback progress accurately. The contributor reports less crackling in Inazuma Eleven 3.

sources.title: audio_core: Fix live looping PCM playback

items.title: Dolphin restores the full signed 16-bit range in DSP audio
items.summary: The audio correction restores −32768 as a valid minimum sample value. Exact saturation limits matter when a decoder reuses previous samples.

items.title: Vita3K corrects AVC frame-memory sizing and argument checks
items.summary: Frame-memory requests are rounded up to multiples of 256 KiB. Invalid calls are checked before decoder state is accessed.

items.title: PPSSPP moves WebSocket debugging work onto the CPU thread
items.summary: A synchronous task bridge replaces distributed debugger locking, and the disassembler drops merged macro-operations that made stepping size ambiguous.

sources.title: Refactor the websocket debug interface to be thread-safe, remove "macro ops" in disasm

items.title: Inside shadPS4: a native C++ and Vulkan approach to PS4 emulation
items.summary: The official project structure shows how shadPS4 combines a native C++ core, platform frontends and a Vulkan-focused graphics path instead of treating compatibility as a single switch.

items.title: Why shader translation is a core shadPS4 compatibility frontier
items.summary: The video-core sources document a translation pipeline that must convert PS4 GPU programs into host-compatible shaders while preserving memory and numeric behavior.

items.title: Azahar accepts both Android URI forms for the same Downloads file
items.summary: The system file picker emits different content URIs for the Downloads sidebar and manual navigation; vanilla Azahar now resolves the provider-backed form instead of rejecting a valid selection.

sources.title: android: Fix inability to access files in the Download folder in some circumstances

items.title: PCSX2 gates Vulkan depth feedback layout on the capability that legalizes it
items.summary: Depth read-only sampling now falls back to GENERAL layout when texture barriers are disabled, avoiding a feedback-loop layout selected without its required Vulkan feature bits.

sources.title: GS:VK: Only use feedback loop layout for depth if texture barrier is supported.

items.title: PGXP reduces PlayStation geometry wobble by tracking precision beyond the original pipeline
items.summary: DuckStation officially supports PGXP geometry precision, texture correction and depth-buffer emulation as optional enhancements.

items.title: Why EmuCoreX treats cover art as recoverable library data
items.summary: A game cover looks decorative, but stale paths, partial downloads, and repeated misses can make an Android library feel unreliable. EmuCoreX isolates downloaded artwork, validates every cached image, and repairs the visible list without touching a user's custom covers.

sources.title: Improve rendering, audio, and cover cache reliability

items.title: PPSSPP gives texture replacement a standalone test harness
items.summary: A synthetic pack and explicit test entry point exercise hashes, ranges, filtering, mipmaps, and missing entries without booting the emulator's renderer.

sources.title: Add TextureReplacer unit test; make replacer testable standalone

items.title: PCSX2 separates menu navigation from per-game controller profiles
items.summary: Static FullscreenUI bindings, a DInput exception, corrected XInput detection, and new Nintendo and generic glyph sets make on-screen prompts match the controls that actually navigate the menu.

sources.title: Input/FullscreenUI: Fix shared-binding navigation bug; fix and expand controller icon/glyph support

items.title: Vita3K distinguishes SPIR-V object IDs from vector lane numbers
items.summary: Vector-shuffle construction now tags source vectors as IDs and component selectors as literals, preventing lane zero from becoming an invalid SPIR-V ID.

sources.title: shader: Fix one case of 'ids can't be 0'

items.title: How shadPS4 turns game tests into useful compatibility evidence
items.summary: The official compatibility workflow records repeatable test results, hardware context and status changes so progress can be measured without relying on a single screenshot.

items.title: PPSSPP gives kernel memory maps a leaner savestate format
items.summary: BlockAllocator now writes a compact record per block and guarantees zero-padded tags when they are created, cutting structural work from large memory maps.

items.title: PPSSPP stops stale helper threads from damaging a restored savestate
items.summary: The savestate loader now detaches old sceUtility and PSMF host wrappers before destruction, protecting live kernel threads and memory that may reuse the same identifiers.

sources.title: Savestate: don't let stale HLE helper threads mutate restored kernel state

items.title: PPSSPP trims savestates by storing only live audio samples
items.summary: A compact queue format serializes the samples that can still be played, rather than copying all nine fixed-capacity audio buffers into every state.

sources.title: Savestate: store only live audio queue data (AudioChannel section v3)

items.title: PCSX2 restores microVU's EATAN coefficient order with bit-level tests
items.summary: A coefficient naming regression in the vector-unit recompiler produced plausible but incorrect arctangent results; manual tables and ps2autotests reveal exactly which constants were shuffled.

items.title: PCSX2 resolves Gamescope's two-step startup resize without reverting to 640x480
items.summary: A delayed resize event could outlive a newer 1280x800 window query; corrected state ordering keeps the final Steam Deck viewport at the dimensions Gamescope actually selected.

items.title: How EmuCoreV turns a glass screen into Vita controls
items.summary: EmuCoreV's touch layer is more than painted buttons. Layout data is normalized and persisted, vector controls keep appearance separate from hit geometry, motion sensors can drive analog axes, and the final state crosses a compact JNI input contract.

items.title: One settings model, many surfaces: EmuCoreV's customization system
items.summary: Background media, cover density, typography, drawer treatment, touch visuals, and game-menu layouts all travel through one observable settings model. The result is broad personalization without each screen inventing its own preference format.

sources.title: Stabilize customization preview and Pro branding

items.title: Inside EmuCoreV: SDLActivity, Compose overlays, and a Vita3K adapter layer
items.summary: EmuCoreV does not wrap a desktop window in an Android theme. Its launch path prepares Vita storage, initializes a Vita3K-derived frontend through a small adapter, gives SDL the rendering surface, and then attaches Android-native controls and menus around the running session.

items.title: Dolphin separates an ELF segment's load address from its virtual address
items.summary: The loader now prefers p_paddr as the segment's load-memory address and falls back to p_vaddr only when no physical address is provided.

sources.title: Core/Boot: Fix ELF load address semantics

items.title: Azahar turns special files into a composable stack of storage layers
items.summary: A new IOFileBase chain lets bounded views, compression, and encryption wrap one another, replacing inheritance that became fragile when multiple special file types had to cooperate.

items.title: PCSX2 orders disc-switch reset before Qt can unpause the VM
items.summary: A deferred reset state was being trampled by VMLock's unpause event; moving the emulation-view transition after reset posting preserves the intended VM lifecycle.

sources.title: Qt: Fix logic for resetting the VM when changing discs

items.title: PCSX2 reconciles FullscreenUI with resume actions coming from Qt
items.summary: External unpause now dismisses controller-first menus, while OSD visibility follows whether any FullscreenUI window is open rather than drawing over both menu and game layers.

sources.title: FullscreenUI: Close menus on resume, hide OSD while open

items.title: PCSX2 lets uploaded image size define a preloaded target's valid area
items.summary: Exact EE-to-GS upload bounds prevent later RTA Scaling from cropping a full image to the tiny region drawn afterward, while one-pixel overlaps stop relocating otherwise valid targets.

sources.title: GS/TC: Set valid size minimum based on exact preloaded target

items.title: Azahar initializes PlayStation button maps before enabling motion
items.summary: Reordering and deduplicating SDL motion activation removes a launch-time threading hazard specific to DualShock 4 and DualSense HIDAPI controller setup.

sources.title: Bugfix for ps4/ps5 controller hang at launch

items.title: GPU readbacks reconnect shadPS4’s host images with guest-visible memory

items.title: PPSSPP fixes a Vulkan device-creation trap on Mali hardware
items.summary: The libretro wrapper now chooses exactly one Vulkan feature channel, satisfying the rule that pEnabledFeatures must be null when VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 is chained.

sources.title: Libretro: fix Vulkan launch crash on Mali devices

items.title: How EmuCoreX splits a PS2 session between Compose, SurfaceView, and native PCSX2 code
items.summary: A PS2 game launched from EmuCoreX crosses several deliberately narrow boundaries before the first frame reaches the display. The Android application, JNI contract, rendering surface, session state, and ARM64 recompilers each own a different part of that path.

items.title: From catalog tap to verified install: EmuCoreX's texture-pack pipeline
items.summary: Large replacement packs need more than a progress bar. EmuCoreX gives every transfer a persistent identity, resumes partial payloads with HTTP ranges, verifies declared sizes and SHA-256 hashes, and installs only after the complete archive passes those checks.

sources.title: Raise texture extraction limit to 12 GiB

items.title: Azahar calibrates legacy trigger centers instead of assuming zero
items.summary: Steam Deck trigger axes can rest near -32767 under SDL's Joystick API; recording the initial center restores old mappings that otherwise report L and R as held.

sources.title: BUGFIX: Legacy joystick triggers on linux

items.title: Dolphin places hard bounds around NetPlay save decompression
items.summary: Safe LZO decoding, checked accumulation, and exact final-size validation prevent remote save blocks from overrunning memory or steering allocation unchecked.

items.title: PCSX2 removes draw-buffer bookkeeping when no batch can use it
items.summary: Disabled or immediately unbufferable draws no longer copy and restore GS environments, while local references replace pointer traffic added to hot rendering paths.

sources.title: GS: Optimize draw buffering and pointer logic

items.title: Dolphin routes real Balance Boards to the correct Android slot
items.summary: Android's DolphinBar scanner now distinguishes a Wii Balance Board from an ordinary remote, matching the device routing already used on desktop platforms.

sources.title: Android: Route DolphinBar Balance Board to the Balance Board slot

items.title: PCSX2 isolates CSM2 palette loading from CSM1's swizzled order
items.summary: A storage-mode switch in Breath of Fire exposed why sequential CSM2 data cannot safely reuse a temporary CLUT buffer populated under CSM1's swizzle rules.

sources.title: GS/CLUT: Handle special case for CSM2 32bit mode switch

items.title: PCSX2 preserves untouched render-target data across partial clears
items.summary: Clear and preload tracking now distinguishes a full overlap from a half-target operation, preventing valid rows from being discarded and copied back as corrupted data.

items.title: PCSX2 limits bilinear depth resizing to real downscales
items.summary: A one-condition texture-cache change separates the case that needs smoothing from copies where interpolation changes depth values and produces shadow or surface artifacts.

items.title: Dolphin derives GameCube memory size from the disc that requests it
items.summary: The bi2.bin simulated-memory field now selects MEM1 within hardware limits, while manual overrides remain available for deliberate experiments.

items.title: PCSX2 gives GameDB families a shared source of compatibility fixes
items.summary: Standard YAML anchors let regional, demo, and promotional SKUs reuse a named fix set, extend it, or override one field instead of copying large blocks that later diverge.
